findings.finding: createProcurementContractSource issues Dashboard Vendor Contracts and readContractSource accepts only dashboard/contracts. Mounted createSfContractInputProducer and createSfContractReviewVerifier require target.surface=procurement. ContractReviewInput's canonical contractProjectionRef is BusinessEvidenceRef and imposes no Procurement-only surface restriction.
findings.proposedDelta: Use the actual dashboard/contracts source selector in the mounted producer and verifier, retaining case membership, exact source digest, current resolution, allowed fields and readContract revalidation. Do not rewrite a returned ref or broaden source access.
findings.actualDriverInputs: Actual dashboard contract source issuance/read; complete C09/C10 alternative; canonical registered document schema; documentIds=[]; missing notice observed through readContract.
findings.readyOutputScope: CommercialGap for an actual missing contract field. Other CommercialGap categories and EvidenceCandidate are not certified by this driver.
requiredTests: Genuine dashboard/contracts source linked to current case prepares successfully.
Procurement request masquerading as contract is refused.
Source outside current case, stale version and changed fields are refused.
The actual output verifier accepts only the currently missing or unavailable field and linked source.

findings.finding: The actual schema resolver accepts schema:<id>:<version> and returns the bare id plus string version. Contract producer compares schema.value.id with the full selected fieldSchemaRef, so every legitimate populated documentIds branch fails that equality.
findings.proposedDelta: Compare the human-selected canonical reference with schema:${schema.value.id}:${schema.value.version}; continue verifying the persisted document's schemaRef and schemaVersion against that resolved identity.
requiredTests: Real admitted document, registered schema, stored extraction and linked current case source use the full canonical schema ref.
Bare id, changed schema version, different document binding and forged DocumentEvidence are refused.
findings.exclusions: Do not label the unused createSfExtractionInputProducer equality as an installed extraction failure: analysis-host-services mounts createSfDocumentAnalysisInput, which correctly resolves canonical refs.
findings.reproducerStatus: Document-producing prerequisites implemented; populated contract-document branch remains NOT_RUN and requires an actual source promotion/claim consumer.

findings.owner: WP10 with the Procurement source/C12 owner
findings.finding: The mounted business context for an individually issued Procurement source contains sourceRefs=[]. Procurement read preserves that context. Purchase preparation requires a nonempty human targets selection and resolves targets only from purchase.context.sourceRefs or existing choice-linked preparedChanges. A real human choice with an ordinary request and no prior preparedChanges therefore has no selectable allowed target.
findings.proposedDelta: Publish or consume the real current allowed-change-target issuer, with exact case/source/field/version/authority binding, or expose the existing legitimate C12 preparation route that supplies those targets. An observed row reference alone must not be treated as authorization to change it.
findings.actualDriverInputs: Two separate installations/tests: real complete or category-omitted Planner alternatives, issued units, registered human criterion, stored ChoiceRecord, actual Procurement request projection and actual sourcing ranking. The human target selector uses observed request id/fields only; no SourceRef is injected into the input.
requiredTests: Ordinary current request and real choice obtain the explicitly authorized target through the owner route.
Outside-case request, changed target fields, stale choice and changed source fail preparation.
DossierDraft reopens without changing the chosen case or Procurement store.
PreparedChangeSet requires the real change proposal store and its exact choice-linked prepared output; not covered by this DossierDraft driver.

findings.finding: includeCommercialComparisons=true is explicitly unavailable with commercial-comparison-binding-unavailable; the verifier also refuses nonempty commercialComparisons. The driver obtains a genuine domain ranking separately and never calls the empty-array mode a full commercial comparison binding.
findings.requiredDelta: Expose the owner-approved stored CommercialComparison binding with current source pins before treating that mode as available.

findings.owner: WP11 claim/acceptance consumer and WP10 input composition; WP00 if a new shared contract is required
findings.finding: The mounted EvidenceReviewInput producer requires nonempty claimIds found in current.case.assumptions. Real case draft initializes assumptions=[]; the inspected analysis acceptance implementation increments version and appends ledger/outbox without materializing assumptions. Native extraction is a candidate and does not create a case claim. This inspection does not assert that every possible external producer was searched.
findings.actualDriverBehavior: Select only current case assumptions; empty set is submitted to the mounted preparer and recorded as needs-input, without synthetic C08 claims. The independent native branch uses only an actual extraction author run/output digest, the same exact caseRef, and asserts a distinct run and native Session.
findings.requiredDelta: Provide and exercise a real human claim/source adoption producer. Preserve the author's exact run/output target and current case version; do not insert claims directly into C08.
